text.formatted: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.
text.plain: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.

text.formatted: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.
text.plain: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +3, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

text.formatted: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object — armor or a weapon — worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 11, the creature with the object. _Failure:_  The object takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.
text.plain: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object — armor or a weapon — worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the creature with the object. Failure:  The object takes a -1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.

text.formatted: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn't being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.
text.plain: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn't being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.

text.formatted: _Trigger:_ An attack roll hits the rust monster. _Response:_ The rust monster uses Antennae.
text.plain: Trigger: An attack roll hits the rust monster. Response: The rust monster uses Antennae.
